description: Explore public Quantum Law concepts, the eight-class curriculum, and professional pathways for lawyers, judges, legal technologists, educators, and organizations. The Guide explains topics including Q-Day, post-quantum cryptography, probabilistic evidence, Identity versus Fidelity, Rule 702, quantum-native verification, and accountable human judgment. It uses public course materials only, provides educational information rather than legal advice, and does not access paid course content, student accounts, or confidential information.
